title: Higher-Dimensional Fourier Series Convergence on Tori
description: Formalizes n-dimensional Fourier analysis infrastructure on tori T^n. Proves dot product linearity (6 theorems), defines Fourier coefficients via integration, and proves linearity. Convergence results documented: L^2 convergence holds in all dimensions, Fefferman divergence for rectangular sums in n >= 2, Carleson conjecture open for n >= 2.
